title: The museum of your ex’s belongings – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: The museum of your ex's belongings – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Boost your listening skills with our B2 pre-advanced listening practice test on relationships and breakups. Transcription is included!

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a video about a very curious museum in Croatia, and for questions 1 to 5, choose the correct answer.
For more videos like this, go to Great Big Story
Questions

questions.prompt: Why did Dražen and Olinka break up?

choices.html: Their relationship was nice but they argued a lot.
They didn't have a lot of things in common.

questions.prompt: What led to the creation of the museum?

choices.html: A discussion about the sentimental value of a trivial item.
The need to preserve sentimental items from their past relationship.
Their interest in uncovering the stories behind exes' belongings.

questions.prompt: What does Drazen say about the donors' descriptions?

choices.html: It was initially a concern to let the donors write the descriptions.
They are very interesting, although sometimes too short.
Some of them are inspired by movies.

questions.prompt: How do Olinka and Dražen describe their experience of working together after their breakup?

choices.html: It wasn't difficult because they always maintained a respectful relationship.
It's been a long learning journey for them.
They didn't think it was possible but they proved it is.

questions.prompt: How do the donors feel about donating their objects?

choices.html: They like the creative process that it inolves.
They're happy to get rid of stuff and help the museum.
